blog.title: The Chapter Leader Playbook

description: A password-protected preview as an unauthorized visitor meets it. On a static host a password can only honestly mean encryption at rest, so the title and body in this page's HTML are AES-GCM ciphertext — View Source, curl and the CDN copy all hold unreadable bytes. The password is stored nowhere, including here; the ciphertext in the seed is real output from encryptPreview, so the form genuinely decrypts rather than pretending to.
